text: The component shall produce one deterministic alert state for each input sample.
The component shall reject input outside the configured operating range.
Invalid numeric values or out-of-range height and vertical speed shall produce INPUT_INVALID.
A valid inhibited sample shall produce INHIBITED before operational alerts are evaluated.
A channel difference above the configured limit shall produce SENSOR_DISAGREE.
Below the configured height threshold, sink rate below the applicable gear threshold shall produce PULL_UP.
A valid sample that satisfies no alert condition shall produce NORMAL.
Configured comparison limits are strict: equality with a limit shall not activate that condition.
